title: 57. Longest Palindromic Substring

examples.explanation: The longest palindromic substring in "babad" is "bab" or "aba" (both length 3).
The longest palindromic substring in "cbbd" is "bb" (length 2).

hints: Expand around centers (both odd and even) to find the longest palindromic substring in O(n^2) time and O(1) space.
